1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits enhanced stability or reactivity compared to the corresponding potassium salt analog__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl and the sodium salt exhibits improved selectivity in enolate chemistry__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium enolate of the β-keto methyl ester demonstrates superior reactivity in 4-aminobut-2-enolide synthesis compared to ethyl ester analogs__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium salt is prepared by a method comprising treatment of the corresponding β-keto methyl ester with a sodium base under controlled conditions__.

5. (Cancelled)
